title: Abyssals v0.90.15 — Quickbite and Angling
notes: Quickbite starts at 40× capture strength, falls to 12× on round 2 and 3× on round 3, then returns to 1× from round 4. A level-65 catch-rate-45 Abyssal at 1 HP has about a 61% opening chance. Fishing keepers can be submitted immediately, with casting open until nightfall. A full saved game-day cooldown runs from the later catch/submission before another daylight entry; travel and save/reload preserve it. Existing contests, prizes, saves, package and original signing certificate are preserved. Tested through GitHub Actions; no physical-phone testing performed.
